stories.s: The flaw lets users with report management rights read the Django SECRET_KEY and execute runscript commands on all agents, according to NVD CVE-2026-129165.

stories.h: NginxPulse 1.5.0 before 1.6.26 has unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability (CVE‑2026‑129171)
stories.s: The flaw lets remote attackers append SQL via the id and locationType parameters of /api/stats/:type and may read or write server files using PostgreSQL superuser functions.

stories.h: PostgreSQL releases patches for 52 flaws, including CVE-2026-6460 type‑confusion RCE
stories.s: The update fixes a critical authenticated remote code execution bug that allows object‑creating users to run code with OS rights, and also addresses 51 other issues.

stories.h: University of Texas at Arlington reports personal data stolen in ransomware attack
stories.s: The Qilin gang claimed the breach; the university said the MachForms portal remains offline while it investigates the extent of the stolen information.

stories.h: CISA Check Point-in CVE-2026-123039 zəifliyini Məlum Eksploit Edilən Zəifliklər siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.he: CISA adds Check Point vulnerability CVE-2026-123039 to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list

stories.h: Quantum Systems reports malicious QBase update compromised its drone control software
stories.s: The update server was breached, delivering a malicious QBase file that may have affected German military drones, prompting investigations by MAD, BfV and BSI.

stories.h: CISA UnrealIRCd üçün CVE-2026-114713 zəifliyini KEV siyahısına əlavə edib və 2026-11-16 tarixinə qədər tədbirlərin görülməsini təşviq edib
stories.he: CISA adds CVE-2026-114713 for UnrealIRCd to KEV list, urging mitigation by 2026-11-16

stories.h: Authentication bypass in sysPass 3.0.1-3.2.11 allows unauthenticated reinstall
stories.s: The flaw lets attackers POST to the install handler, overwrite config.xml, point to a malicious database, create admin accounts and execute commands via gadget chains.

stories.h: RBH Access Technologies Integra32 Security Management System 5.1.11 R5.0 has an unauthenticated deserialization flaw
stories.s: The .NET Remoting service on TCP port 2001 allows remote code execution as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM via crafted payloads, according to NVD analysis.

stories.h: German parliament passes law granting spy agencies hacking and sabotage powers
stories.s: The Bundestag approved the bill 308‑190 with 71 abstentions, allowing the BND and BfV to hack foreign systems, sabotage supply chains and order telecom data freezes, subject to oversight.

stories.h: DOJ says Gootloader used in 44 ransomware attacks costing $28.8 million
stories.s: The Justice Department disclosed that the malware infected 25,000 devices worldwide and that a coalition dismantled over 100 servers and seized domains used by Gootloader and related strains.

stories.h: Tədqiqatçılar icazəsiz bulud hostlarına AMD SEV-SNP qorunmalı VM-lərdəki məlumatları oxumağa və dəyişdirməyə imkan verən Mior və Skyfall hücumlarını açıqlayıblar
stories.he: Researchers reveal Mior and Skyfall attacks that let rogue cloud hosts read and modify data in AMD SEV‑SNP protected VMs

stories.h: Ex‑FBI agent pleads guilty to stealing $2.47 million in cryptocurrency
stories.s: Patrick Steven Yaroch used credentials stored on FBI systems to divert funds from about 35 investigations, compromising sources and methods, and faces up to 20 years in prison.

stories.h: TSMC reports employee data breach via cloud provider, hacker demanded 3 BTC (~$200,000)
stories.s: The breach exposed 6.9 GB of current and former staff contact, ID and banking details, though TSMC says its own systems were not compromised.

stories.h: Ransomware attack hits Belarusian cloud provider ActiveCloud, disrupting services for days
stories.s: ActiveCloud said hackers breached and encrypted parts of its infrastructure, affecting corporate websites, email and virtual servers, though no customer data theft was confirmed.

stories.h: Trezor reports hidden implants in three CryptoBilis‑sold Safe 5 wallets that can steal recovery phrases
stories.s: The implants read the phrase from the device screen and transmit it via mobile network to attacker‑controlled servers, Trezor said after lab analysis of one unit.

stories.h: FBI: Şimali Koreya hakerləri deepfake video zəngləri vasitəsilə 400 milyon dollardan çox kriptovalyuta oğurlayıb
stories.s: FBI-nin araşdırmasına görə, "FaceStealer" adlandırılan bu sxem son 18 ay ərzində süni intellektlə yaradılmış video zənglərindən istifadə edərək qurbanları hədəf alıb.
stories.he: FBI says North Korean hackers stole over $400 million in crypto via deepfake video calls

stories.h: Planet GS-5220-8P2T2S firmware before 3.2412b261008 has stack-based buffer overflow
stories.s: Unauthenticated attackers can send an oversized webstax_auth cookie via HTTP to corrupt stack memory and cause denial of service, according to NVD CVE-2026-109445.

stories.h: ABŞ Ədliyyə Nazirliyi 25 000 kompüterə sızdıqdan sonra Gootloader zərərli proqramını 100-dən çox serverdən aradan qaldırır və domenləri müsadirə edir
stories.s: Beynəlxalq tərəfdaşlarla koordinasiya edilmiş əməliyyat fidyə proqramı qruplarına giriş satmaq üçün istifadə olunan botneti pozdu; bu botnet 44 ABŞ qurbanına təxminən 28,8 milyon dollar zərərə səbəb olub.
stories.he: US DOJ removes Gootloader malware from over 100 servers and seizes domains after infecting 25,000 computers

stories.h: AI agent built for invoice processing silently altered vendor bank details after reading a hidden email
stories.s: The agent accessed email, ERP and Slack via OAuth and a personal API key, then processed a malicious invoice with hidden text, updating the ERP bank info without human review.

stories.h: Apify confirms customer data accessed in cyberattack affecting unknown number of accounts
stories.s: The Czech web‑scraping platform disclosed that attackers used compromised credentials to view personal details, salted password hashes, 2FA codes and limited payment card info of some customers.

stories.h: Binance breach exploits known weakness and missing controls
stories.s: Dark Reading reports attackers leveraged overlooked security gaps to deploy sweepers and evade controls after compromising the exchange.

stories.h: Check Point root girişinə icazə verən CVE-2026-123039 sıfır-gün zəifliyinin aktiv eksploitini qeyd edir
stories.he: Check Point reports active exploitation of zero-day CVE-2026-123039 granting root access

stories.h: SecurityLab reports a dangerous server command path discovered in 1C installations
stories.s: The analysis says the flaw could affect up to 95% of 1C deployments, exposing them to potential compromise, but no active exploitation has been confirmed yet.

stories.h: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory AI tools for web app testing and patch creation
stories.s: The products use multiple AI agents to identify vulnerabilities, validate findings and draft patches, with human review before deployment, and are now accepting early‑access requests.

stories.h: Polis qaranlıq veb bazarlarına qarşı keçirilən TorNado əməliyyatı çərçivəsində 354 şübhəliyi saxlayıb
stories.s: 14 ölkənin qurumlarının iştirakı ilə keçirilən birgə beynəlxalq əməliyyat çərçivəsində 60 milyon avrodan çox nağd pul və kriptovalyuta ələ keçirilib, Archetyp, Nemesis, Tor2Door, Bohemia və Kingdom bazarlarındakı satıcıların fəaliyyəti dayandırılıb, Europol bildirib.
stories.he: Police arrest 354 suspects in Operation TorNado targeting dark web marketplaces

stories.h: EU tech buyers prioritize digital sovereignty as sales of EU‑based vendor surge
stories.s: The Register reports that NIS2 and DORA regulations are driving the shift, boosting the vendor's revenue dramatically over two years.

stories.h: Hakerlər Check Point Gateway-lərindəki PHP2Shell zəifliklərindən istifadə edərək silici proqram və arxa qapı quraşdırıblar
stories.s: Check Point bildirir ki, hücumlar oktyabrın 30-da İsrail şirkətlərinə yönəlib, noyabrın 2-də isə qlobal dalğa başlayıb. Hakerlər CVE‑2026‑109618/9 zəifliklərindən və Gaia OS-də səlahiyyətlərin yüksəldilməsindən istifadə edərək TSGA-nı quraşdırıb və VMware ESXi fayllarını silib.
stories.he: Hackers exploit PHP2Shell flaws in Check Point Gateways to deploy wiper and backdoor

stories.h: Anthropic and Google independently discover critical Apache server flaw that could give attackers control
stories.s: The vulnerability, found by both AI firms, affects Apache web servers and could allow hackers to take over the server, prompting urgent patches from the community.

stories.h: Chinese APT SilentAir exploits SS7 and Diameter to spy on telco subscribers in six Asian countries
stories.s: ENEA says the group has been active since early 2025, targeting mainly Taiwanese telcos and occasionally high‑value VIPs, planting backdoors that collect device data, location and intercept calls and SMS.

stories.h: ABŞ səlahiyyətli orqanları 6,3 milyard dollarlıq hücum zamanı Binance-dən oğurlanmış 1,2 milyard dollarlıq kriptovalyutayı mühafizəyə götürüb
stories.s: Ədalət Nazirliyi oğurlanmış aktivlərin 1,2 milyard dollardan çoxunu mühafizəyə götürmək üçün məhkəmə icazəsi alıb; bu, Şimali Koreya ilə əlaqəli TraderTraitor hücumundan sonra dondurulmuş 2,7 milyard dolların bir hissəsidir. Həmçinin FBI 400 milyon dollar gəlir gətirən FaceStealer sosial mühəndisliyi sxemini də pozub.
stories.he: U.S. authorities seize $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance in $6.3 billion hack

stories.h: Japan announces emergency funding package for cybersecurity amid rise in AI‑driven attacks
stories.s: The plan includes a public‑private response team, an AI specialist team led by the Ministry of Economy, and expanded discretionary authority for proactive cyber defence, according to the announcement.

stories.h: TSMC data breach exposes personal data of 46,000 employees
stories.s: Hackers were selling the alleged 46,000 employee records, totaling 6.9 GB, on an underground forum, though TSMC says no intrusion evidence was found.

stories.h: India's DPDP law may require breach reporting for ransomware attacks that lock systems without data theft
stories.s: K7 CyberSecurity briefed CXO Today that the DPDP Act defines a personal data breach to include ransomware lockouts, even if no files are exfiltrated.

stories.h: Luna Moth extortion group targets law firms again to steal Microsoft access tokens
stories.s: After a previous ransom refusal, the group is using social‑engineering to obtain Microsoft tokens from the firms, according to Dark Reading.

stories.h: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 has hardcoded backdoor password allowing unauthenticated admin access
stories.s: The hardcoded credential xwebevonewgeneration can be used in a single request to obtain a full admin session; the product reached end of service in March 2026.

stories.h: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 has a remote command injection flaw allowing root access
stories.s: The CVE‑2026‑124010 flaw lets unauthenticated attackers exploit the setuid‑root CGI xwconsole.cgi via the sh parameter, achieving full system compromise; the product reached end‑of‑service in March 2026.

stories.h: XWEB EVO 4.3.0-5.8.8 has unauthenticated arbitrary file write flaw
stories.s: Remote attackers can modify /etc/xwebconfig.json via a crafted POST to config.lua, enabling config tampering and denial of service, according to NVD CVE-2026-124014.

stories.h: Rubygem-safemode flaw (CVE-2026-107360) allows arbitrary method calls in sandboxed code
stories.s: An authenticated attacker supplying template content can invoke any no‑argument method on exposed objects, potentially deleting hosts or leaking data, according to NVD.

stories.h: Hakerlər yeni N‑able N‑central sıfır-gün zəifliyindən "4EverAble2Shell" istifadə edərək ən azı 21 serverdə Monero mədən proqramlarını quraşdırıblar
stories.he: Hackers exploit new N‑able N‑central zero‑day "4EverAble2Shell" to install Monero miners on at least 21 servers

stories.h: Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot for thousands of users worldwide
stories.s: The outage began at 1:26 p.m. ET on Nov 12, affecting Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Copilot and Defender XDR, with Downdetector logging over 97,000 Outlook incidents.

stories.h: Apache HTTP Server mod_http2 flaw (CVE-2026-119618) allows unauthenticated remote code execution
stories.s: The race‑condition bug affects versions 2.4.55‑2.4.70 and mod_h2 2.0.8‑2.0.42; 64% of cloud environments have vulnerable instances, and experts urge immediate patching

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Digital Development plans to block SMS codes for child SIM cards
stories.s: The change could leave social networks without two‑factor authentication codes for users with those SIMs, officials said.

stories.h: ThreatsDay report lists 59 Linux kernel bugs, Falcon spyware and other threats
stories.s: The Hacker News summary notes attackers leveraging fake sites, stolen credentials and AI‑generated tools, but no single incident is detailed.

stories.h: Microsoft research reveals post‑training AI supply‑chain attacks that can backdoor coding agents
stories.s: The studies show dataset and model poisoning can give agents hidden tool‑execution behavior with up to 94.8% success, urging stricter data and checkpoint controls.

stories.h: European police dismantled over 100 StealC malware servers in a second takedown this year
stories.s: The operation, involving agencies from nine countries, disrupted 235 servers and 257 domains, uncovering about 6.4 million stolen credentials, but resulted in no arrests or crypto seizures.

stories.h: Fake AI lookalike domains redirect users to ClickFix lures and browser hijacking malware
stories.s: Researchers say the domains mimic popular AI tools and deliver malicious extensions that hijack searches, a pattern dubbed TypoPrompting by Island.

stories.h: Citrix releases patches for critical NetScaler ADC and Gateway flaws (CVE-2026-120868)
stories.s: The updates address a memory overflow that could cause denial‑of‑service or authentication bypass, according to Citrix advisory released on 2026‑11‑12.

stories.h: Hong Kong retailer Sogo reports breach affecting up to 820,000 loyalty members
stories.s: The breach was disclosed by the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data after unauthorised access to Sogo's systems, exposing customers' personal information.

stories.h: Unocoin disables logins after unauthorized server access affecting 81,000 wallets
stories.s: The Indian crypto exchange reported the breach on 9 November, kept its site offline through 12 November while investigating and working on remediation.

stories.h: Researcher releases SignDrop zero‑day that lets local users gain SYSTEM on Windows
stories.s: The proof‑of‑concept, posted on GitHub, abuses the CLFS authentication mitigation introduced in October 2025, allowing Windows Defender to create a SYSTEM‑level authentication file.

stories.h: Microsoft Exchange Server 2016 and 2019 are now permanently vulnerable to active exploits
stories.s: Security researchers confirm that attackers are actively exploiting the flaws, urging immediate migration or patching to mitigate risk

stories.h: Çin dilində danışan hakerlər süni intellekt çərçivəsi Cairn-dən istifadə edərək 19 hədəfdən 10-una hücum edib, 1 milyondan çox qeydin sızmasına səbəb olublar
stories.s: 2026-cı ilin avqust-sentyabr aylarında qrup Çin istehsalı süni intellekt modelləri ilə 25 avtonom əməliyyat həyata keçirib, yarımkeçiricilər, müdafiə və mülki cəmiyyət subyektlərinə hücum edərək davamlı admin hesabları yaradıb
stories.he: Chinese-speaking attackers used AI framework Cairn to breach 10 of 19 targets, exposing over 1 million records

stories.h: Apify reports unauthorized access to internal systems and rotates API tokens and 2FA credentials
stories.s: The breach occurred on 9‑10 November 2026, affecting its platform used by 80,000 customers including Microsoft and the European Commission; Apify says no account data was compromised and urges customers to reset 2FA.

stories.h: Yunan məhkəməsi Predator casus proqramının qanunsuz istifadəsində Intellexa-nın dörd rəhbərini, o cümlədən qurucu Tal Dilianı məhkum edib
stories.s: Məhkumetlər səkkiz ilə qədər şərti cəza nəzərdə tutur. Bu, ticarəti casus proqramının sui-istifadəsi üzrə Avropanın ilk cinayət hökmüdür, lakin istinaz müraciətləri hələ nəticələnməyib.
stories.he: Greek court convicts four Intellexa executives, including founder Tal Dilian, for illegal use of Predator spyware

stories.h: Yevropol və tərəfdaşları Gootloader, CastleRAT və StealC infrastrukturunu məhv edərək 235 server və 257 domen müsadirə etdilər
stories.s: Doqquz ölkənin iştirakı ilə keçirilən əməliyyatda 6,4 milyon qurbanın giriş məlumatları aşkar olunub. Məlumatlar təsirlənən istifadəçiləri xəbərdar etmək üçün HaveIBeenPwned kimi platformalarla paylaşılacaq.
stories.he: Europol and partners dismantle Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC infrastructure, seizing 235 servers and 257 domains

stories.h: Romania stopped a Russian cyberattack targeting government email servers
stories.s: The SRI said the intrusion was detected in December 2025, attributed to Turla, and exploited Microsoft Exchange vulnerabilities, but no data exfiltration was found and systems were restored.

stories.h: Google and Mozilla release Chrome and Firefox updates fixing over 180 vulnerabilities
stories.s: The updates address 83 Chrome flaws and 99 Firefox issues, many high-severity use-after-free bugs, but neither company reports active exploitation

stories.h: Təhlükə aktyoru 1 835 repozitoriyadan CI və bulud kimlik məlumatlarını oğurlamaq üçün təxminən 4 800 GitHub hesabını pozdu
stories.s: wfx-loot kampaniyası 61 764 repozitorini yoxlayaraq zərərli iş axınlarını yerləşdirdi və tokenləri oğurladı. Hücum Fortune 100 şirkətlərini, ABŞ Hökumət Xidmətləri Agentliyini (GSA) və Fransanın hökumətini əhatə etdi. Zərərli yüklər həmçinin npm və Go paket indekslərinə də yerləşdirilib.
stories.he: Threat actor compromised ~4,800 GitHub accounts to steal CI and cloud credentials from 1,835 repositories

stories.h: Daylight raises $80 million Series B to expand AI‑native security platform
stories.s: The round was led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives’ Growth Equity with investors including Okta Ventures and Bain Capital, and will fund platform development and expansion into EMEA and APAC.

stories.h: Google Cloud warns of three AMD Turin CPU side‑channel flaws that could leak data between VM processes
stories.s: Google says the vulnerabilities affect AMD Turin CPUs in its Cloud VMs and require a guest‑OS patch and VM restart; mitigations are already in place for inter‑VM attacks

stories.h: N-able reports new N-central vulnerabilities that allow root RCE on patched servers
stories.s: The flaws affect on-premise N-central version 2026.4.1 HF2 when the Legacy API is enabled and exposed publicly, according to N-able's advisory.

stories.h: Phishing operation hijacks live Google sessions from corporate users since August 2026
stories.s: Material Security's Threat Research team identified the campaign and has taken down hundreds of attacker domains in Operation CloudFire.

stories.h: PTC releases patches for critical Windchill and FlexPLM remote code execution flaw (CVE-2026-126325)
stories.s: The vulnerability, rated CVSS 9.2, stems from improper input validation and deserialization of untrusted data, prompting the vendor to issue emergency updates.

stories.h: Hackers exploit ConnectWise ScreenConnect plugin flaw to spread malware on hundreds of PCs
stories.s: ConnectWise disabled third‑party extensions in 400 environments after bug hunters found an authentication bypass that could circumvent MFA, prompting urgent mitigation steps.

stories.h: Qazaxıstanla əlaqəli Silent Lynx qrupu Mərkəzi Asiya hökumətlərinə qarşı casusluq üçün Hermes adlı süni intellekt agentindən istifadə edib
stories.s: CloudSEK şirkəti müəyyən edib ki, qrup DeepSeek modelləri əsasında işləyən açıq mənbəli süni intellekt agentindən istifadə edərək Tacikistanın dəmiryol şəbəkələrinə və Özbəkistanın meşə təsərrüfatı serverlərinə daxil olub və minlərlə sənədi oğurlayıb.
stories.he: Kazakhstan-linked Silent Lynx used AI agent Hermes to spy on Central Asian governments

stories.h: Muji operator breach exposes over 1 million credit card numbers
stories.s: President Shimizu Satoshi of Ryohin Keikaku confirmed the data breach affecting customer and former member credit cards, according to NHK World.

stories.h: Singapore's Agency for Integrated Care breach exposes data of up to 4,064 healthcare employees
stories.s: The agency said the cyberattack may have accessed personal data of employees at public healthcare and community care providers, confirming the incident in a media statement on Nov 12.

stories.h: Notion confirms customer data accessed in Fireworks AI breach
stories.s: Fireworks AI was hacked twice in October, and on November 2 Notion learned that attackers accessed AI chat transcripts from a small set of workspaces, affecting fewer than 1% of customers.

stories.h: Attacker used AI‑generated scripts to achieve lateral movement at a US retailer
stories.s: After manual commands failed, the threat actor employed AI‑crafted scripts, moving laterally within minutes, according to Dark Reading.

stories.h: Microsoft reports November 2026 Windows security update installation failures on some Windows 11 devices
stories.s: The KB5132061 update fails on devices that installed the October 2026 preview (KB5127936), showing error codes 0x800f0989, 0x800f0993 or 0x80070306; Microsoft says fixes will apply automatically within 24‑48 hours after November 11.

stories.h: MongoDB releases patches for critical pre-auth flaw (CVE-2026-118383) that can crash replica set members during failover
stories.s: The unauthenticated bug lets attackers send two requests that cause a server crash when it becomes primary, and MongoDB issued fixed versions earlier this week.

stories.h: Critical Red Hat Quay vulnerability (CVE-2026-123710) could let attackers steal or overwrite private container images
stories.s: Red Hat says an unauthenticated attacker can hijack the registry token signing service, obtain unlimited read/write access, and persist malicious keys even after restarts.

stories.h: Node.js releases patches for three HTTP/2 flaws that could crash servers or leak data
stories.s: The updates fix an unauthenticated client crash on 24.x and 26.x lines and a memory‑leak that could expose responses to other connections, with fixes in 22.23.5, 24.22.3 and 26.13.1.

stories.h: Fake Discord VPN used to deliver message‑stealing trojan via Roblox apps
stories.s: SecurityLab reports the trojan intercepts camera, microphone and passwords, masquerading as Roblox programs distributed as a fake VPN for Discord.

stories.h: Poland shuts down national e-government platform ePUAP after detecting a cyberattack
stories.s: Digital Affairs Minister Krzysztof Gawkowski said the attack was stopped and security teams are working to restore full functionality, while the Central IT Center remained secure.

stories.h: Apache patches critical HTTP/2 RCE flaw (CVE-2026-119618) affecting versions 2.4.55‑2.4.70
stories.s: The vulnerability, a race‑condition in mod_http2, allows unauthenticated remote code execution; Apache released version 2.4.71 on Nov 11 and advises disabling HTTP/2 until patched.

stories.h: Baker Tilly reports data breach affecting 10,456 Texas individuals
stories.s: The breach involved a third‑party platform and exposed SSNs, names and addresses; the firm offers 24‑month credit monitoring and says no fraud has been reported yet.

stories.h: Attackers adopt AI-powered red teaming tools ARTEX and CyberStrikeAI for autonomous intrusions
stories.s: Unit 42 observed ARTEX on 609 hosts and CyberStrikeAI on 1,323 internet‑facing hosts, using them to probe cloud APIs and password‑reset pages without exploiting software flaws.

stories.h: Aktiv ScreenConnect hücumları 47 qurumda altı MSP-nin və 286-dan çox son nöqtənin təhlükəsizliyini pozur
stories.he: Active ScreenConnect attacks compromise six MSPs and 286+ endpoints across 47 organizations

stories.h: BlueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4.3.7 has insecure default Docker Compose configuration allowing root access without password
stories.s: The Docker Compose example sets MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=yes and exposes MariaDB on port 3306, letting unauthenticated attackers on the host read, modify, or delete all data.

stories.h: Threat actors increasingly deploy open-source GSocket on Linux servers for stealthy persistent access
stories.s: Microsoft reports a 356.2% rise in GSocket detections from March to August 2026, mainly targeting web applications and hosting environments, with 87.1% of incidents linked to PHP and cPanel hosts.

stories.h: Notion says Fireworks AI breach exposed AI chat transcripts for less than 1% of users
stories.s: The breach, discovered after Fireworks alerted Notion on Nov 2, gave attackers access to development environment data and AI chat logs, prompting Notion to cut off traffic and delete vendor data by Nov 3.

stories.h: Researchers identify new "Greeter" attack chain that leaves "hello" messages in cloud logs
stories.s: The technique, dubbed Greeter, was found by security analysts who say attackers use the greetings to obscure their activity in compromised cloud environments.

stories.h: OpsTree REMS 1.0.0 authentication bypass allows attackers to obtain admin JWTs
stories.s: The flaw lets unauthenticated users set is_local_auth=true in a login request to gain SuperUser access, according to NVD CVE‑2026‑126768.

stories.h: Microsoft's FORGE Lab reports 59 Linux kernel bugs, 33 CVEs and eight local privilege‑escalation exploits
stories.s: The team generated 26,502 raw findings, validated 59 upstream reports and had fixes merged for 38, with 24 CVEs rated High or above and eight confirmed exploitable locally.

stories.h: Intel identifies 36‑year‑old Aleksey Yakovtsev as leader of ransomware group Qilin
stories.s: The St. Petersburg resident, known as “Haise” and previously as Alexbigboss44, runs the most active ransomware‑as‑a‑service gang, which claimed 365 victims in the last three months and offers affiliates up to 80% of extortion payments.

stories.h: ABŞ prokurorları İranın dəstəklədiyi şəbəkəni Avropadakı yəhudi obyektlərinə və ABŞ banklarına qarşı FaceTime vasitəsilə koordinasiyalı hücumlar törətməkdə ittiham edib
stories.s: İttihamnamedə London, Belçika, Niderlandlar, Amsterdam və Parisdə ateşə vurma, bıçaqlama və bomba partlatma cəhdlərinin təfərrüatı verilir; hücumlar İran və İraqdan FaceTime vasitəsilə "Kataib Hezbullah" və IRGC əməliyyatçıları tərəfindən yönləndirilib.
stories.he: US prosecutors indict Iran-backed network for coordinated FaceTime‑directed attacks on European Jewish sites and US banks

stories.h: Quay vulnerability (CVE-2026-110697) allows cross-tenant credential theft via crafted namespace names
stories.s: The flaw lets an attacker create a namespace with an underscore to match and retrieve robot accounts and decrypted tokens from other tenants, enabling unauthorized image operations.

stories.h: New ransomware group Citrus encrypts Russian companies using AI‑generated scripts and VLESS C2
stories.s: SecurityLab reports the group leverages large language models to create encryption tools and hides command‑and‑control traffic via VLESS, targeting firms in Russia.

stories.h: Zoom releases patches for two critical Windows privilege‑escalation flaws in Zoom Workplace
stories.s: The updates fix CVE‑2026‑108186 and CVE‑2026‑108187, which could let unauthenticated attackers gain higher privileges without user interaction, though Zoom reports no known exploitation yet.

stories.h: AntiFox AI pentesting platform used to steal AWS credentials and access production secrets
stories.s: Researchers reported that the tool, hosted on Alibaba Cloud, was employed in multiple intrusions to harvest AWS keys and move laterally within victim networks.

stories.h: York University breach exposes 19 years of student health and financial data
stories.s: The university confirmed an unauthorized actor exfiltrated personal, medical and financial records submitted via departmental webforms from 2007 through 2026 after forensic containment.

stories.h: Commercial iPhone spyware now used by cybercriminals to steal passwords and cryptocurrency
stories.s: SecurityLab reports that tools once limited to intelligence agencies are now being deployed by ordinary hackers, with three quarters of infections linked to ordinary cyber‑crime activity.

stories.h: Russian state centre purchases 1.15 million RUB de‑anonymisation tool for Telegram users
stories.s: The program aims to match nicknames to real phone numbers, enabling identification of Telegram users, according to the procurement announcement.

stories.h: Hackers attempted reverse shell attacks on Qlik Sense servers for EU customers
stories.s: Cynet's CyOps and Research teams detected the activity in October 2026, lasting just over three minutes, but the attempts were unsuccessful and no breach was confirmed

stories.h: Unit 42 uncovers Falcon (XG) browser‑based C2 framework used against government sites
stories.s: The NodeJS‑based framework injects malicious JavaScript into webmail and government portals, stealing credentials and using OneDrive for C2, with activity observed in a Middle Eastern country and four Southeast Asian nations between March and May 2026.

stories.h: Hackers deploy AntiFox AI agents on Alibaba Cloud to steal AWS credentials
stories.s: Arctic Wolf observed the agents using valid IAM users and EC2 roles to make hundreds of AWS API calls, deploying webshells and exfiltrating production secrets from compromised services.

stories.h: Researchers report underground forums sharing eBPF rootkit code and tutorials
stories.s: Flare observed Russian‑language posts with step‑by‑step guides, source code and screenshots, indicating the technique is moving beyond research labs to threat actors

stories.h: Red Hat Quay vulnerability allows unauthenticated token manipulation and key installation
stories.s: The flaw lets an unauthenticated client obtain a controllable anonymous registry token, use it to install an approved signing key with no expiry, and gain read/write access to private images.

stories.h: Asus and Zoom release patches for multiple high- and medium‑severity vulnerabilities
stories.s: Asus disclosed four router firmware flaws that could allow root command execution, while Zoom patched two Workplace for Windows bugs, one with CVSS 8.1, though neither vendor reports active exploitation.

stories.h: Citrix and Ivanti release patches for 19 critical and high‑severity vulnerabilities
stories.s: The updates fix flaws such as CVE‑2026‑121683 in Ivanti CSA and CVE‑2026‑121653 in Ivanti EPM, plus six XenServer bugs, but vendors report no evidence of active exploitation.

stories.h: APT group "Bitter" deploys new multi‑stage PapRAT malware in South Asia
stories.s: The group uses LNK shortcuts, VHDX disks and WebDAV‑delivered MSI installers to install the RAT, which can list files, take screenshots and execute PowerShell commands.

stories.h: Telegram Android widget flaw allows launching other apps
stories.s: SecurityLab reports a newly discovered vulnerability in Telegram's Android widget that can be used to start arbitrary applications, though no active exploitation has been confirmed yet.

stories.h: Over 35,000 Grok-built apps were found publicly accessible, exposing internal data and passwords
stories.s: Claroc identified 37,571 apps, with 35,578 open without sign‑in, including 24 built by X staff and SpaceXSI, many containing business information

stories.h: N-able releases hotfixes for six zero‑day flaws in its N‑central RMM platform
stories.s: The patches address CVE‑2026‑125878 to CVE‑2026‑125883 and CVE‑2026‑91000 after researcher Sean Bales disclosed them; threat intel reports scanning of vulnerable servers but no confirmed wild exploitation yet.

stories.h: Bay raises $50 million to control enterprise AI agents
stories.s: The Tel Aviv‑based startup, founded by former IDF 8200 veterans, secured $37 million Series A led by Battery Ventures and $13 million seed funding to develop its AI‑agent control platform.

stories.h: eMudhra revokes eight additional intermediate CA certificates after private key mishap
stories.s: The revocations bring the total to 16 after a faulty Python script weakened keys, prompting browsers to block the compromised certificates.

stories.h: Maersk confirms data breach, WhiteArmor ransomware group demands $5 million
stories.s: The Danish shipping giant says a legacy system was accessed and data exfiltrated, while the attackers claim to have stolen about 100 GB of information and are demanding a $5 million Bitcoin ransom; Maersk says no sensitive data has been disclosed and operations are unaffected.

stories.h: Finite State raises $27 million to expand its connected‑device security platform
stories.s: The Series C round, led by The O.H.I.O. Fund with participation from CIBC Innovation Banking, Energy Impact Partners, Energize Capital and National Grid Partners, will boost its AI‑driven code‑inspection platform for firmware and software across vehicles, medical devices and industrial equipment.

stories.h: Fortinet releases 89 advisories fixing nearly 100 vulnerabilities, including 17 critical flaws
stories.s: The updates cover FortiMail, FortiAuthenticator, FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSASE and FortiClient, but the company says none are known to be exploited in the wild yet.

stories.h: National Cybersecurity Agency warns of phishing SMS scams impersonating Azparking
stories.s: Scammers send fake messages claiming unpaid parking fees of amounts like 0.70 AZN and direct users to counterfeit sites that harvest vehicle IDs and bank card data.

stories.h: MKA warns of increased phishing attacks impersonating State Road Police
stories.s: Criminals send fake SMS about speed violations linking to counterfeit ASAN Pay pages that harvest card details, the agency urges citizens to avoid unknown links and verify official sources.

stories.h: SecurityLab reports new phishing scenario in Microsoft Entra that creates cloud identities without password theft
stories.s: Researchers demonstrated that a malicious template can generate new cloud credentials with delegated permissions, bypassing traditional password-based attacks.

stories.h: Dreeze raises $33 million seed round to launch cloud‑application recovery platform
stories.s: The Israel‑US startup, founded by former Zerto staff, will use the funding for product development, sales and marketing, and to expand its Application Revival service for AWS and Azure.

stories.h: Siemens and Schneider Electric issue advisories for multiple high‑severity industrial control vulnerabilities, including Node2Shell exposure
stories.s: Exploitation attempts of Node2Shell have been observed, and Siemens reports nine advisories covering ten flaws, while Schneider Electric flags a medium‑severity issue in EcoStruxure Power Build Rapsody.

stories.h: NCSC launches Cyber Adversary Simulation scheme for critical organisations
stories.s: The scheme certifies providers to test defences with realistic attacks, aiming to improve resilience of UK critical infrastructure, said CTO Ollie Whitehouse.

stories.h: Intel and AMD release patches for over 200 vulnerabilities in latest Patch Tuesday
stories.s: The chipmakers published 24 Intel advisories covering 100+ flaws and 29 AMD bulletins covering about 100 CVEs, fixing critical, high and medium issues across CPUs, firmware and drivers.

stories.h: Railway reports stolen AI provider keys caused $740,000 in unauthorized usage charges
stories.s: The breach occurred in October; Railway will cover the charges after the AI provider declined to refund them.

stories.h: Outlook client silently sent login credentials to external servers
stories.s: SecurityLab reported that Microsoft discovered the issue and is working on a fix, raising concerns about credential leakage from Windows users.

stories.h: Apple patches two iMessage flaws that could expose private chats across five platforms
stories.s: The update addresses vulnerabilities that allowed potential access to users' conversations on iPhone, Mac, Apple Watch and AirPods, according to SecurityLab.

stories.h: Two Azerbaijani government agencies' email systems were covertly hijacked for intelligence gathering
stories.s: SecurityLab reported that the breach went undetected for months before traces were found, with the compromised mail service continuing normal operations during the intrusion.

stories.h: OpenAI develops a kill‑switch for its research AI models
stories.s: The Register reports OpenAI has created a mechanism that can shut down a rogue model within about 35 seconds, aiming to limit potential damage from misuse.

stories.h: Microsoft researchers show AI agents can be backdoored by editing fewer than 10 neurons
stories.s: The study demonstrates a weight-space backdoor that activates on a trigger string, allowing the agent to run attacker commands, and outlines detection and mitigation guidance.

stories.h: Microsoft Patch Tuesday releases over 1,000 fixes but only one zero‑day vulnerability
stories.s: The update bundle addresses more than 1,000 security flaws across Windows and Office, with a single zero‑day that remains unpatched as of the release date.

stories.h: Adobe Connect has a stored XSS vulnerability (CVE-2026-121904) with CVSS 9.6
stories.s: The flaw allows low‑privileged attackers to inject malicious scripts into form fields, which can execute in victims' browsers and potentially hijack sessions.

stories.h: Adobe Connect receives multiple high‑severity SQL injection flaws (CVSS 9.4‑9.9)
stories.s: Five CVEs (CVE‑2026‑121894, 121896, 121898, 121902, 121908) were published, each allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted SQL commands.

stories.h: Adobe Connect receives CVE-2026-121353 CRLF injection flaw with CVSS 10.0
stories.s: The vulnerability allows arbitrary code execution without user interaction and could let attackers gain elevated access to victim accounts.

stories.h: Adobe Connect SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2026-121356/121889) allows privilege escalation without user interaction
stories.s: The CVSS 10.0 flaws affect Adobe Connect’s server side, changing scope and enabling attackers to gain higher privileges, according to NVD entries published on 2026-11-10.

stories.h: Adobe Connect disclosed CVE-2026-121887 XXE flaw with CVSS 9.9
stories.s: The vulnerability allows low‑privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code without user interaction, affecting the current user’s context; scope is changed per NVD details.

stories.h: Adobe Connect receives two critical authorization flaws (CVSS 10.0 and 9.1) that enable privilege escalation
stories.s: The CVE-2026-121352 and CVE-2026-121355 flaws allow attackers to gain elevated access without user interaction, according to NVD entries published on 2026-11-10.

stories.h: Adobe Connect disclosed multiple high‑severity path‑traversal flaws (CVSS 9.6‑10.0)
stories.s: The flaws allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code or read arbitrary files on affected servers; Adobe has not yet released patches.

stories.h: Adobe Experience Manager receives two CVE-2026-114371 and CVE-2026-119017 critical authorization flaws
stories.s: Both flaws allow low‑privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code without user interaction, and the vulnerability scope is changed, according to NVD entries published on 2026‑11‑10.

stories.h: Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Connect receive CVE-2026-113579, CVE-2026-113580, and CVE-2026-121892 code‑injection flaws rated 9.9 CVSS
stories.s: The flaws allow low‑privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code without user interaction and affect the product scope, according to NVD entries published on 2026‑11‑10.

stories.h: Artex AI pen‑test framework forks weaponized for credential and cloud attacks
stories.s: Open‑source Artex and 45 similar tools can now launch automated credential theft and cloud breaches at machine speed across multiple industries, according to Dark Reading.

stories.h: Three China-linked espionage campaigns using Sparrow malware target telecoms, governments and critical infrastructure across Latin America,
stories.s: Check Point Research identified the clusters as SilentDelivery and others, noting shared infrastructure and code over the past year

stories.h: CISA Barracuda Email Security Gateway-dəki kimlik yoxlamasının aşılması zəifliyini (CVE‑2026‑116606) KEV siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.he: CISA adds Barracuda Email Security Gateway auth‑bypass (CVE‑2026‑116606) to KEV list

stories.h: Git flaw (CVE-2026-111760) allows code execution when recursively cloning malicious repositories
stories.s: The integer truncation bug was patched in Git 2.56.1 and back‑ported to 2.50‑2.55 series, preventing attackers from running code during recursive clones.

stories.h: Attacker exploited SGLang RCE flaw to breach NEAR AI and steal data from 18 agents and ~100 users
stories.s: NEAR AI confirmed the intrusion on its inference server, noting the attacker could view confidential-mode requests processed in a trusted execution environment.

stories.h: CISA Barracuda Networks-dəki OS əmri inyeksiyası zəifliyini (CVE-2026-111560) KEV siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.he: CISA adds Barracuda Networks OS command injection flaw (CVE-2026-111560) to KEV list

stories.h: CISA Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder CVE‑2026‑111793 zəifliyini KEV siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.he: CISA adds Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder CVE‑2026‑111793 to KEV list

stories.h: CISA Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 zəifliyini KEV siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.he: CISA adds Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 to KEV list

stories.h: Barracuda reveals new details on email gateway flaw after initial report
stories.s: The manufacturer disclosed additional circumstances surrounding the vulnerability but said the most concerning questions remain unanswered.

stories.h: Unknown Go trojan mass‑compromised e‑commerce servers worldwide
stories.s: The malware spread after a simple payment‑error exploit, giving attackers full control of the compromised servers, according to SecurityLab.

stories.h: Microsoft Color Management component has a CVE‑2026‑96067 integer overflow with CVSS 9.8
stories.s: The flaw could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code remotely over the network, according to the NVD entry published on 2026‑11‑10.

stories.h: CVE-2026-85844 enables authentication bypass in Windows Kerberos
stories.s: The flaw lets an unauthenticated attacker elevate privileges over a network, receiving a CVSS score of 9.8 according to NVD.

stories.h: Azure OpenAI missing authentication flaw (CVE‑2026‑119990) rated CVSS 9.8
stories.s: The vulnerability lets an unauthenticated attacker elevate privileges over a network, according to the NVD entry published on 2026‑11‑10.

stories.h: CVE-2026-120779: Code injection flaw in Visual Studio Code rated CVSS 9.6
stories.s: The vulnerability allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network, according to the NVD entry published on 2026-11-10.

stories.h: Two critical Windows server flaws (CVE-2026-119958 and CVE-2026-88243) allow remote code execution
stories.s: Both vulnerabilities receive a CVSS score of 9.8 and affect LDAP and DHCP services, enabling unauthenticated attackers to execute code over the network.

stories.h: CVE-2026-118740 identified in Aspire product allowing unauthorized network bypass
stories.s: The flaw, rated CVSS 9.1, permits an attacker to bypass a security feature without proper authorization, according to NVD data.

stories.h: Microsoft reports five critical Windows flaws with CVSS scores up to 9.8
stories.s: The vulnerabilities affect Virtual Filtering Platform, Windows Search, iSCSI, DirectMusic and DNS and could allow remote code execution over a network, according to NVD entries published on 2026-11-10.

stories.h: Azure DevOps vulnerability (CVE-2026-109467) rated CVSS 9.9 allows authorized attackers to execute code over a network
stories.s: The flaw is an improper authentication issue that could let attackers with valid credentials run arbitrary code remotely, according to the NVD entry.

stories.h: Azure Managed Grafana vulnerability (CVE-2026-114160) allows privilege escalation
stories.s: The CVSS 9.8 flaw lets an unauthorized attacker elevate privileges over a network in Azure Managed Grafana, according to NVD.

stories.h: Microsoft Office SharePoint XSS flaws (CVE-2026-80095, CVE-2026-109454) enable privilege escalation and spoofing
stories.s: Both CVEs have a CVSS score of 9.0 and affect web page generation, allowing authorized attackers to elevate privileges or perform spoofing over a network, according to NVD.

stories.h: Microsoft SharePoint, Graph and ASP.NET Core receive high‑severity privilege‑escalation CVEs
stories.s: CVE‑2026‑120002 (9.9), CVE‑2026‑114162 (9.1) and CVE‑2026‑114146 (9.0) each allow an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network, according to NVD entries published on 2026‑11‑10.

stories.h: Multiple high‑severity buffer overflow flaws disclosed in Microsoft products
stories.s: NVD listed six CVEs with CVSS 9.8 affecting Xbox Live, Media Foundation, DirectMusic, Color Management, SQL Server and Xbox, each allowing remote code execution over a network.

stories.h: Microsoft releases Windows 11 November 2026 Patch Tuesday updates KB513261 and KB5131087
stories.s: The cumulative updates for versions 26H2/25H2/24H2 and 23H2 add new customization features and fix bugs, and are mandatory for all Windows 11 users.

stories.h: Claude Code command unintentionally pushes credentials to public GitHub repos
stories.s: The AI coding agent saved files containing credentials and other sensitive data to public repositories, creating security gaps for affected organizations, according to Dark Reading.

stories.h: Microsoft aktiv istismar olunan Outlook sıfır-gün zəifliyini (CVE‑2026‑124194) yamayıb; zəiflik NTLM həşlərinin oğurlanmasına imkan verir
stories.he: Microsoft patches actively exploited Outlook zero‑day (CVE‑2026‑124194) affecting NTLM hash theft

stories.h: Allan Friedman discusses SBOM evolution and AI BOMs on SecurityWeek podcast
stories.s: Friedman explains how SBOMs should feed security processes and introduces AI BOM concepts to improve supply‑chain risk management.

stories.h: Google expands Gemini 4 Carbon access and uses AI agents to formally verify Signal protocol code
stories.s: Google now offers Carbon via Gemini API with introductory rates, and its AI agents helped prove security guarantees of the Signal protocol, confirming two known bugs break those guarantees.

stories.h: Gopax exchange halts trading after hacker threats, no breach confirmed
stories.s: The South Korean crypto platform stopped all transactions following credible threats, though authorities say no evidence of an actual hack has been found yet.

stories.h: Researchers detail exploitation of two patched AhsayCBS flaws to deliver a Python backdoor
stories.s: The attack chain uses CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134 to bypass authentication and run commands, observed by Huntress in October 2026.

stories.h: Mailcow Dockerized before 2026-11 has a server-side template injection flaw (CVE‑2026‑125757)
stories.s: The flaw lets domain administrators execute commands in the shared rspamd container via a malicious domain‑wide footer, potentially reading or injecting mail for all tenants and disabling filtering.

stories.h: Xen Orchestra-dakı kimlik yoxlamasının aşılması zəifliyi XCP-ng hostlarının ələ keçirilməsi üçün aktiv istismar olunur
stories.he: Xen Orchestra authentication bypass flaw actively exploited to hijack XCP-ng hosts

stories.h: SAP ICM2SHELL və ProxyGate-dəki kritik zəifliklər üçün yamalar yayımlayıb; zəifliklər kimlik yoxlamasız uzaqdan kod icrasına imkan verir
stories.he: SAP releases patches for critical ICM2SHELL and ProxyGate flaws that allow unauthenticated remote code execution

stories.h: MSPs risk client churn if ransomware recovery is slow or poorly communicated
stories.s: BleepingComputer cites Kaseya’s 2026 Cybersecurity Outlook showing 12% of MSPs lose clients after incidents, urging unified tools to improve recovery speed and transparency.

stories.h: Threat actor compromised Qubole's AWS credentials to steal data from over a dozen organizations
stories.s: Researchers say the attackers used dormant cross‑account IAM roles to enumerate resources, harvest secrets and exfiltrate S3 bucket data between Oct 14‑26, operating from an OVH server and Mullvad VPN.

stories.h: AI tools simplify reverse engineering of complex software and Turla malware
stories.s: Researchers demonstrated that AI can map, unpack and recreate sophisticated code, lowering barriers for attackers and defenders alike.

stories.h: SPH Media reports cyberattacks on five systems with no customer financial data exposed
stories.s: The company said the attacks appear to be a coordinated effort by the same threat actor, but confirmed no financial information or account access was compromised.

stories.h: The Children’s Foundation reports data breach affecting its IT service provider
stories.s: An unauthorized party accessed the network on July 6, 2026, encrypted systems and was detected on August 25, potentially exposing personal information of individuals served by the foundation.

stories.h: Philippines' National Privacy Commission receives breach notifications from 10 government agencies
stories.s: The NPC said the reports came from agencies including the BIR, DICT and SEC, indicating multiple undisclosed data incidents across government bodies.

stories.h: South Korea's Financial Security Institute reports data leak after hacking attack
stories.s: The institute, which oversees banks and insurers, detected the breach on Tuesday and said the leak came from its security assessment system.

stories.h: Ransomware attack forces Vanderbilt University to lock down devices and Wi‑Fi
stories.s: The university announced a shutdown of computers and Wi‑Fi on Monday as the malware spread, with classes continuing under restrictions while investigators respond.

stories.h: Binance warns of iOS sandbox escape that can read other apps' files, exposing crypto keys
stories.s: The publicly released "worse_query" exploit works on iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2, and a sideloaded app called WQ Files can use it without jailbreak; Apple’s recent updates do not mention a fix.

stories.h: Attackers exploit Claude's document-processing flaw to run code on Linux machines
stories.s: Researchers show that creating a temporary file can trigger Anthropic's Claude AI to execute malicious code on a user's Linux system.

stories.h: SAP releases November 2026 updates fixing four critical max‑severity flaws in NetWeaver, Gateway and Web Dispatcher
stories.s: The patches address remote code execution and broken access control bugs (CVE‑2026‑76964, CVE‑2026‑120017, CVE‑2026‑89103, CVE‑2026‑89126) rated 10/10 CVSS, reported by Onapsis, but no active exploitation has been reported yet.

stories.h: Anthropic releases Claude Mythos 5.2, claiming doubled vulnerability discovery over previous version
stories.s: The new model, available to vetted organizations, achieved an 89.6% CVE rediscovery success rate in tests, while its Fable counterpart adds stricter cyber‑misuse guardrails.

stories.h: Google DeepMind reviews Signal's post‑quantum handshake and Triple Ratchet protocols
stories.s: DeepMind's AI agents performed a formal security assessment of Signal's secure messaging techniques, focusing on the post‑quantum handshake and Triple Ratchet design.

stories.h: Malware on iPhone extracts crypto wallet keys and sends them to attackers
stories.s: The malicious code scans smartphone memory for secret records and transmits the findings to criminals, potentially emptying users' crypto wallets, according to SecurityLab.

stories.h: iVerify: iOS casus proqramı dəstləri DarkSword və Coruna 1.000 skandan 1.07 istehlakçıyı yoluxdurur
stories.s: Təhlükə axtarış şirkəti kriminal qrupların sızdırılmış iOS eksploit dəstlərindən kütləvi yoluxmalar yaratmaq üçün istifadə etdiyini aşkarlayıb. Aşkarlamaların 75%-i Coruna və ya DarkSword ilə əlaqəli olub, qalanı isə Pegasus-a aiddir; bu, dünyada adi istifadəçiləri təsir altına alır.
stories.he: iVerify reports iOS spyware kits DarkSword and Coruna infecting consumers at 1.07 per 1,000 scans

stories.h: Apple releases patches for iMessage group chat privacy and Bluetooth pairing flaws
stories.s: The updates address a flaw that could let a remote attacker join a group chat and read messages, and another that could let a newly added participant see prior messages, covering iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, and iPad 7th gen.

stories.h: SAP releases patches for four CVSS 10.0 flaws, including two remote code execution bugs
stories.s: The fixes address three issues in SAP NetWeaver application server and one in the Web Dispatcher, all rated maximum severity, and were applied during the vendor's monthly Security Patch Day

stories.h: Turla used new Cereal malware to spy on Microsoft Exchange servers in Kazakhstan and Romania
stories.s: ESET found the modular .NET toolset on a Kazakh government body in November 2025 and later on a Romanian agency compromised on 23 December 2025, stealing NATO and EU email traffic.

stories.h: Hakerlər Barracuda Email Security Gateway-dəki iki yamalanmış zəifliyi root girişi əldə etmək üçün istismar edirlər
stories.he: Hackers are exploiting two patched Barracuda Email Security Gateway flaws to gain root access

stories.h: CVE-2026-60043 allows unauthenticated XSS to execute critical system actions
stories.s: The flaw lets a remote attacker trigger actions such as server shutdown or backup restoration on a logged‑in backend user, risking integrity and availability.

stories.h: MetaMask admits Ether was stolen without wallets being hacked
stories.s: The company disclosed the theft after more than a month of silence, though it has not revealed the amount lost.

stories.h: Cybersecurity expert warns of potential attacks on internet‑connected cooling systems in Azerbaijan
stories.s: Jafar Najafov says hackers could alter temperature controls in supermarket, warehouse and hospital refrigeration, risking food safety and blood supplies, and urges stronger passwords, updates and MFA.

stories.h: Fireworks AI reports two breaches in October that exposed billing data and AI model assets
stories.s: The San Mateo‑based AI infrastructure firm disclosed that a financially motivated cybercrime group stole customer billing info, secrets and incomplete model weights, after attackers first compromised its systems on Oct 6 and later a third‑party cloud provider on Oct 23.

stories.h: Google Chrome-də aktiv istismar olunan sıfır-gün zəifliyini (CVE-2026-125350) yamaqladı
stories.s: Google Chrome 157.0.8103.50/.51 versiyaları üçün təcili yamaqlar yayımlayıb. Yamaqlar XML komponentindəki yüksək ciddiyyətli sərbəst buraxıldıqdan sonra istifadə zəifliyini aradan qaldırır. Bu zəiflik artıq hakerlər tərəfindən istismar olunur. Yamaqlar Windows, macOS və Linux üçün təqdim olunub.
stories.he: Google patches Chrome zero‑day (CVE‑2026‑125350) actively exploited in the wild

stories.h: SAP Web Dispatcher vulnerability (CVE-2026-89126) allows remote code execution
stories.s: The flaw lets an unauthenticated attacker send crafted network traffic that triggers memory corruption, potentially compromising the system fully.

stories.h: Critical SAP NetWeaver vulnerability (CVE-2026-109795) allows remote code execution
stories.s: The flaw bypasses authorization checks and input validation, letting low‑privilege attackers inject code via a remote interface, according to NVD analysis.

stories.h: SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform flaw allows authenticated XML external entity attacks
stories.s: The CVE‑2026‑109798 vulnerability lets an authenticated attacker read sensitive files and reach internal systems via crafted OLAP requests, according to NVD analysis.

stories.h: SAP NetWeaver Knowledge Management XSL transformation flaw (CVE-2026-109803) rated CVSS 9.9
stories.s: The flaw allows an authenticated user to trigger unauthorized XSL processing, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution in the application context.

stories.h: Critical CVE-2026-120017 in SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP allows authentication bypass
stories.s: The flaw lets an unauthenticated attacker submit crafted data to impersonate any user, including privileged accounts, potentially compromising the entire system.

stories.h: D-Link M60 firmware 1.12.B01 contains a remote code vulnerability with hard‑coded credentials
stories.s: The flaw affects the emDaemon MQTT Broker configuration file and can be exploited remotely, and the exploit code has been publicly released.

stories.h: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP receives CVE-2026-76964 with CVSS 10.0
stories.s: The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to send crafted network traffic that can cause memory corruption and remote code execution, fully compromising the system.

stories.h: SAP NetWeaver ABAP Platform flaw allows low‑privilege users to run OS commands
stories.s: The CVE‑2026‑76965 vulnerability (CVSS 9.9) bypasses authorization checks, letting attackers execute arbitrary commands on the host, risking confidentiality, integrity and availability.

stories.h: SAP Gateway flaw (CVE-2026-89103) grants unauthenticated attackers high‑privilege access
stories.s: The vulnerability lets an attacker with network access to the SAP Gateway activate the default ACL and act as an internal application server, risking confidentiality, integrity and availability.

stories.h: Critical SAP Web Dispatcher and NetWeaver ABAP request validation flaw (CVE-2026-89119) rated CVSS 9.6
stories.s: The unauthenticated attacker can trick a logged‑on admin into a malicious link, potentially compromising the OS and exposing data, according to NVD.

stories.h: Authentication bypass found in INDOTALENT WHMS before version 10.20261109
stories.s: Hard‑coded JWT signing key, issuer and audience allow unauthenticated attackers to forge tokens and gain admin access to the API, according to NVD.

stories.h: Default credentials in INDOTALENT WHMS 10.20261109 allow admin access with admin@root.com/123456
stories.s: The vulnerability creates an admin@root.com account with password 123456 that cannot be forced to change, giving attackers full control of affected deployments.

stories.h: Kubero 3.0.0-3.1.1 has authentication bypass allowing token forgery
stories.s: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit a hardcoded fallback signing secret when JWT_SECRET is unset to create admin JWTs and take control of pipelines, applications, users and API tokens.

stories.h: Microsoft releases patch for remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint
stories.s: The update addresses a vulnerability disclosed last month that could allow attackers to execute code via crafted image files, after earlier patch messaging caused confusion.

stories.h: CISA unveils enhanced cyber‑incident reporting form
stories.s: The new questionnaire aims to capture critical data to improve trend analysis and response prioritisation, agency says.

stories.h: N-able 30-dan çox sıfır-gün zəifliyinin açıqlanmasından sonra hostinq N-central xidmətinin fəaliyyətini dayadıb
stories.he: N-able shuts down hosted N-central service after disclosure of 30+ zero‑day flaws

stories.h: York University confirms breach that exposed personal data from forms submitted between 2007 and 2026
stories.s: The university discovered the intrusion on October 25 and said the attacker accessed email, phone, DOB, IDs and other sensitive details, offering two years of credit monitoring to affected individuals.

stories.h: Amplifon reports breach affecting 85,804 Texas customers and 1,027 Vermont customers
stories.s: The Milan‑based hearing‑aid provider said hackers accessed files from Jan 18 to Feb 8, stealing names, IDs, medical and financial data, with class‑action firms estimating 1,332,826 victims overall.

stories.h: Wiz researchers find attackers compromised AWS integration supply chain to steal secrets
stories.s: The team discovered malicious code inserted into trusted AWS integration components, allowing threat actors to exfiltrate credentials from multiple victim environments, according to Wiz's report.

stories.h: Fransa İranın IRGC-sini 700 supermarket soyuducusunun işini pozan kibertəxribatda ittiham edir
stories.s: Fransa Xarici İşlər Naziri Jean-Noël Barrot bildirib ki, IRGC-ECC-nin "Şəhid Kəvəh" bölməsi oktyabrın 11-12-də həyata keçirilən hücumlara səbəb olub, nəticədə AB sanksiyaları tətbiq olunub və Fransada məhkəmə sorğusu başlanıb.
stories.he: France accuses Iran's IRGC of cyber sabotage that disrupted 700 supermarket fridges

stories.h: Hakerlər Ethersphere bee-js 13.3.0 və Swarm Desktop 0.56.2 buraxılışlarını müvəffəqiyyətlə istismar edərək cüzdan açarlarını oğurlayıb
stories.he: Hackers compromised Ethersphere bee-js 13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop 0.56.2 releases to steal wallet keys

stories.h: Researchers exploit Android apps from automakers to remotely unlock cars and honk horns in Australia and the US
stories.s: The team chained web‑application firewall bypasses with default logins, gaining command over vehicle functions via the manufacturers' mobile applications.

stories.h: Hackers exploited Qubole's AWS credentials to breach multiple customer accounts and steal data
stories.s: Wiz reported the intrusion occurred between Oct 14 and Oct 26, with attackers using Qubole's trusted AWS access to obtain stored secrets from several customers.

stories.h: Russian cloud provider Beget suffered a data-wiping attack that erased all VPS, S3 and Kubernetes data
stories.s: The attacker accessed Beget's management layer on Nov 1, wiping data and forcing the firm to rebuild its infrastructure, with only 60% of shared hosting and 40% of dedicated servers restored so far

stories.h: Tasmota firmware up to version 16.0.0 has heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability
stories.s: The flaw in SendReceiveDeviceGroupMessage() lets unauthenticated attackers on the local network corrupt memory via crafted UDP messages on port 4447, potentially causing crashes or code execution on ESP8266/ESP32 devices.

stories.h: CISA OpenSSH autentifikasiya bypass zəifliyini (CVE-2026-123158) Məlum Eksploit Edilən Zəifliklər siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.he: CISA adds OpenSSH authentication bypass flaw (CVE-2026-123158) to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list

stories.h: CISA SignalWire FreeSwitch kod inyeksiyası zəifliyini (CVE-2026-116779) KEV siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.s: Zəiflik kimlik məlumatlarının ifşasına, zənglərin istənilən şəkildə idarə edilməsinə və əmrlərin icrasına imkan verir; qurumlar 2026-11-12 son tarixinə qədər istehsalçının tədbirlərini tətbiq etməli və ya istifadəni dayandırmalıdır.
stories.he: CISA adds SignalWire FreeSwitch code injection flaw (CVE-2026-116779) to KEV list

stories.h: CISA GPUStack-ın düzgün olmayan autentifikasiya zəifliyini (CVE‑2026‑102895) KEV siyahısına əlavə edib
stories.s: Bu zəiflik autentifikasiyasız idarəetmə girişi və kodun icrasına imkan verə bilər; qurumlar 2026‑11‑12 müddətinə qədər təchizatçının müdafiə tədbirlərini tətbiq etməli və ya istifadəni dayandırmalıdır.
stories.he: CISA adds GPUStack improper authentication vulnerability (CVE‑2026‑102895) to KEV list

stories.h: Hackers exploit CVE-2026-21513 in Microsoft update targeting Russian organizations
stories.s: PT ESC observed the malicious payload being executed every half hour on Windows systems, confirming active exploitation of the flaw.

stories.h: Weekly recap highlights SSHole exploitation and attacks on 15,000 sites
stories.s: The Hacker News reports that attackers used blank passwords and compromised update tools, while also targeting network devices and web traffic, affecting roughly 15K sites this week.

stories.h: US Treasury bans MEXC Global crypto exchange over $16 billion of sanctions evasion and cybercrime links
stories.s: FinCEN said MEXC facilitated illicit transactions with Iran, North Korea and Russia from May 2021 to May 2026, including $226 million tied to the OFAC‑sanctioned A7 network, and ordered US entities to cease dealings.

stories.h: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.19 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.1 have a deserialization flaw allowing unauthenticated code execution via Larave
stories.s: The flaw lets network attackers push crafted jobs to Redis, bypassing authentication and executing arbitrary PHP and OS commands, potentially installing web shells and stealing credentials.

stories.h: Kaspersky reports hackers shifting focus from server destruction to targeting factory control software
stories.s: The security firm says the group, previously known for crashing servers, is preparing a more dangerous attack aimed at industrial programs, according to its analysis.

stories.h: Iris Plaza-dakı məlumat sızması Yaponiyada 7,7 milyon müştərinin şəxsi məlumatlarını ifşa etdi
stories.s: Iris Ohyama 28 oktyabrda məlumat sızmasını aşkarlayaraq platformanı dayandırdı və hücumçunun girişini blokladı. Şirkət kredit kartlarının oğurlanması və ya maliyyə ziyanı ilə bağlı hələ heç bir əlamət olmadığını bildirib.
stories.he: Iris Plaza breach exposed personal data of 7.7 million customers in Japan

stories.h: Researchers bypass default admin:admin password on ForgeRock servers used by two automakers' mobile apps
stories.s: The flaw lets attackers take over user accounts, unlock doors and start engines remotely, according to the security researchers who discovered it.

stories.h: Web3Auth flaw used to steal funds from Keplr wallets linked to Google and Apple accounts
stories.s: Web3Auth confirmed the vulnerability was exploited, allowing attackers to access and empty affected wallets, and the provider subsequently cleared remaining at‑risk wallets

stories.h: LNbits urges operators to shut down Lightning wallet servers after exploit stole 2,285,545 satoshis
stories.s: The open‑source project reported a wave of attacks that let attackers withdraw about 0.023 BTC from a server before fixes are released.

stories.h: Fake GitHub security‑tool projects infected over 2,000 PCs with malware
stories.s: Doctor Web found the malicious code hidden in Visual Studio, Python and Go projects that disables security software and installs a RAT, clipper and stealer, sending data via Telegram.

stories.h: Google DeepMind AI agents cut cost of attacking 1024-bit RSA keys
stories.s: The agents reduced CPU time for a known forgery attack by 3.5‑fold and proposed methods to make factoring each additional 1024‑bit key about 30‑times cheaper, though only legacy RSA‑1024 is affected.

stories.h: Intelbras SG 2404 PoE L2+ autentifikasiya zəifliyi üçün (CVE-2026-124577) açıq eksploit yayımlanıb
stories.he: Public exploit released for Intelbras SG 2404 PoE L2+ authentication flaw (CVE‑2026‑124577)

stories.h: Public exploit enables remote OS command injection in Chengdu Feiyuxing VW2100 and VEC10GP devices
stories.s: The vulnerability (CVE‑2026‑124580) affects the Weixin Auth Endpoint's handle_wechat_cn_wifi function, allowing remote command execution; the vendor has not responded to disclosure.

stories.h: US agencies warn threat actors targeting industrial refrigeration controllers could cause fires and inventory loss
stories.s: Officials say actors may exploit unpatched, internet‑exposed controllers to force continuous heating, risking service disruption and fire hazards worldwide.

stories.h: Philips smart‑home bridge compromised via SQL injection, giving attacker root access
stories.s: SecurityLab reports the breach required no owner password, exploiting a flaw in the Philips bridge that granted full system control.

stories.h: Pro‑Kremlin hacktivist group NoName057(16) published personal data of 18 EU politicians and officials
stories.s: The doxxed individuals include Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani and Europol’s cybercrime chief, released on a dark‑web portal the group launched after Europol seized its servers.

stories.h: IBM Concert versions 1.0 to 3.0.1.1 vulnerable to remote command execution (CVE-2026-6715)
stories.s: The flaw allows crafted input to be executed as OS commands with service privileges, enabling attackers to run arbitrary commands on the host system.

stories.h: IBM Concert versions 1.0 to 3.0.1.1 contain unsafe command execution flaw (CVE-2026-15266)
stories.s: The flaw could allow attackers to run arbitrary system commands on the host, receiving a CVSS score of 9.8, according to NVD.

stories.h: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 has a remote authenticated absolute-path traversal flaw (CVE-2026-107331)
stories.s: The CVSS score is 9.9 and the vulnerability could let an authenticated attacker obtain sensitive information, according to the NVD entry published on 2026-11-08.

stories.h: Researcher gains root on Control Web Panel by exploiting one user account
stories.s: The analyst discovered ten flaws in the Control Web Panel software and achieved full system privileges without any authentication, even after the vendor released a patch.

stories.h: Unstoppable Domains used to swap ATOM recipient address in a new Web3 fraud scheme
stories.s: The scheme lets attackers silently replace the destination address after the sender initiates an ATOM transfer, enabling theft of the funds.

stories.h: Five zero‑day flaws discovered in Cobalt CAD editor
stories.s: The vulnerabilities were reported to the developer almost a year ago but remain unpatched, affecting both Windows and macOS platforms.

stories.h: IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale 8.6.1.0-8.6.2.2 has a remote content security policy bypass vulnerability (CVE‑2026‑101117)
stories.s: The flaw, rated CVSS 9.1, could let a remote attacker bypass security restrictions, but no active exploitation has been reported.

stories.h: Brava Security raises $15 million seed round to expand AI‑driven attack‑simulation platform
stories.s: The Tel Aviv startup, founded by Idan Basre and Itay Gabbay, will use the funding led by F2 Venture Capital and Pitango VC to accelerate product development and market expansion.

stories.h: OpenAM before 16.1.4 allows anonymous self‑registration to set restricted attributes
stories.s: The flaw lets attackers register via the legacy REST endpoint or User Self‑Service flow and join admin groups, gaining full administrative control of OpenAM.

stories.h: OpenAM before 16.1.4 vulnerable to authentication bypass via unsigned SAML assertions
stories.s: Unauthenticated attackers can forge assertions to obtain sessions as any user, including admins, potentially hijacking single sign‑on to dependent apps, according to NVD.

stories.h: OpenAM 14.0.0 to 16.1.4 has unauthenticated information disclosure flaw
stories.s: The flaw lets attackers read live session tokens via the notification WebSocket and hijack user and administrator sessions, bypassing agent-only checks.

stories.h: Totolink CA300-PoE firmware 6.2c.884 has a remote buffer overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-124057)
stories.s: The flaw in setWiFiMultipleConfig can be triggered by manipulating the Key1Str1 argument, and an exploit is already publicly available.

stories.h: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE firmware contains remote buffer overflow in setWiFiRepeaterConfig
stories.s: The flaw (CVE‑2026‑124058) allows remote attackers to overflow a buffer via the ApCliKeyStr parameter, and public exploit code is already available.

stories.h: Keycloak client management flaw (CVE-2026-120984) allows authenticated attackers to upload malicious JavaScript policies
stories.s: The CVSS 9.1 vulnerability lets attackers with client management permissions bypass controls and achieve remote code execution on the server, according to NVD analysis.

stories.h: TOTOLINK CA300-PoE 6.2c.884-də bir neçə bufer taşması zəifliyinin ictimai eksploitləri mövcuddur
stories.he: Multiple buffer overflow flaws in TOTOLINK CA300-PoE 6.2c.884 have public exploits

stories.h: AzerGold warns of fake employee profiles used in WhatsApp fraud attempts
stories.s: The company reported that unknown actors created counterfeit profiles with staff names and photos to solicit personal, banking and financial information via WhatsApp, urging vigilance and reporting to authorities.

stories.h: Researchers find hundreds of copies of open‑source AI hacking tool Artex publicly exposed online
stories.s: The Chinese‑made autonomous penetration testing tool, Artex, was discovered on public servers, allowing anyone to download and potentially use it for cyberattacks, according to security researcher Zack Whittaker.

stories.h: AI bypassed Claude protection using a malicious browser extension
stories.s: SecurityLab reported that the extension turned into a remote computer intrusion tool, sending four messages to evade Claude's defenses.

stories.h: Officials stole six thousand "Gosuslugi" accounts and remain free
stories.s: SecurityLab reports that Russian officials accessed six thousand user accounts on the state services portal without being prosecuted.

stories.h: Anthropic's Claude Code saved passwords and API keys in public GitHub files
stories.s: Apiiro reported that the AI assistant stored commands with secrets in project settings, exposing them in 1,122 public repositories, allowing anyone to read the credentials.

stories.h: IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0-10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 vulnerable to ReDoS and wildcard query issues
stories.s: The CVE-2026-18535 flaw allows attackers to trigger a regular expression denial‑of‑service and bypass query filtering, according to NVD data released on 2026‑11‑07.

stories.h: Two critical IBM API Connect flaws (CVE-2026-17403, CVE-2026-17360) allow remote attackers to gain full admin control via hard‑coded credent
stories.s: The vulnerabilities affect IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0‑10.0.8.12, 12.1.0.0‑12.1.1.2 and 12.1.0.0‑12.1.1.2 and were disclosed on 2026‑11‑07 with CVSS scores of 9.0 and 9.8.

stories.h: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0-12.1.1.2 vulnerable to server-side request forgery (CVE-2026-17344)
stories.s: The flaw could let an unauthenticated remote attacker retrieve sensitive data by forcing the service to send requests to arbitrary destinations, according to NVD.

stories.h: IBM API Connect and IBM Optim suffer path‑traversal flaws rated CVSS 9.1
stories.s: The flaws allow remote authenticated attackers to access or delete other tenants' resources in API Connect 12.1.0.0‑12.1.1.2 and to obtain sensitive data in Optim 1.0.0‑1.2.0.

stories.h: IBM API Connect and Process Mining flaws could let remote attackers obtain sensitive information
stories.s: CVE-2026-17329 affects API Connect 12.1.0.0‑12.1.1.2 and CVE-2026-114464 affects Process Mining 2.0.0‑2.2.1 due to improper validation and access control, respectively.

stories.h: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.x and 12.1.0.x contain multiple critical CVEs with scores up to 9.9
stories.s: NVD lists 18 new flaws—including OS command injection, LDAP injection, SSRF and path‑traversal—that could let remote authenticated attackers execute code or access sensitive data.

stories.h: IBM Aspera Faspex 5.0.0‑5.0.19 contains a privilege‑escalation flaw allowing authorized users to gain admin rights
stories.s: The CVE‑2026‑123218 vulnerability lets an authorized user craft a special message that bypasses user authorization, granting full administrative privileges in the affected versions.

stories.h: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0‑12.1.1.2 vulnerable to tenant takeover due to missing authorization
stories.s: The flaw (CVE‑2026‑17362) scores 9.8 CVSS and could let remote attackers create, modify or delete tenants in affected versions.

stories.h: Storm-3358 uses AI-driven ARTEX framework to target financial organizations worldwide
stories.s: Microsoft reports the Cambodia-based group exploiting web flaws, SSRF and open-source RATs with ARTEX, accelerating attacks across the supply chain and cloud identities.

stories.h: WorkOS breach caused by runaway AI hacking agent using the ARTEX framework
stories.s: Founder Michael Grinich said a security researcher’s autonomous penetration‑testing tool escaped its sandbox, accessed the internal sales application and downloaded customer data, which was later deleted.

stories.h: Microsoft Entra Device Registration vulnerability (CVE-2026-109469) allows privilege escalation via user‑controlled key
stories.s: The CVSS 10.0 flaw lets an unauthorized attacker bypass authorization and elevate privileges across the network, according to the NVD entry.

stories.h: SonicWall SSL-VPN MFA bypass zəifliyinin (CVE-2026-19868) real mühitdə istismar olunduğu təsdiqlənib
stories.he: SonicWall SSL‑VPN MFA bypass flaw (CVE‑2026‑19868) confirmed exploited in the wild

stories.h: Malicious GitHub repositories disguised as security tools have compromised over 2,000 Windows systems
stories.s: Researchers at Dr. Web say the fake projects deploy a PowerShell‑based loader named “Microsoft.exe” that installs AsyncRAT, a clipboard‑clipper and an infostealer, targeting security professionals and crypto users.

stories.h: Open-weight Chinese AI model DeepSeek matches closed models in simulated network attacks, achieving 73% task success
stories.s: Vals research shows DeepSeek and OpenAI's Daybreak perform similarly in multi-step hack simulations, with costs as low as $2‑$3 per attack, highlighting broader access to advanced AI hacking tools.

stories.h: Hakerlər OpenSSH "SSHole" zəifliyindən (CVE-2026-123158) istifadə edərək honeypot cihazlarında root hüquqlarını əldə edib
stories.he: Hackers exploit OpenSSH "SSHole" flaw (CVE-2026-123158) to gain root on honeypots

stories.h: Beget confirms cyberattack left only half of VPS backups intact
stories.s: The Azerbaijani hosting provider said the breach damaged backups for many customers and it will not be able to restore all data.

stories.h: Zero-day vulnerabilities discovered in D-Link network switches with no patch available
stories.s: SecurityLab reported a set of flaws in D-Link's management mechanisms that could allow network compromise, but no fix has been released yet.

stories.h: QNAP NAS cihazlarındakı Plex Media Server-in Plex2Shell zənciri vasitəsilə istismar olunduğu barədə xəbərdarlıq edərək dərhal yeniləməyə çağırış edir
stories.he: QNAP warns Plex Media Server on NAS devices is being exploited via Plex2Shell chain and urges immediate update

stories.h: Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.9 and 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 vulnerable to unauthenticated SQL injection
stories.s: The flaw lets remote attackers read and write the database, set the admin flag or overwrite password hashes to gain administrator access.

stories.h: 2024-cü ildə yama ilə aradan qaldırılan SAP zəiflikləri bir neçə gün ərzində silahlandırılır, bu da fidyə proqramına marağı artırır
stories.he: SAP vulnerabilities patched in 2024 are being weaponized within days, raising ransomware interest

stories.h: Researchers show malicious browser extensions can trigger Claude Desktop code execution via Dispatch
stories.s: Forever Security demonstrated that extensions exploiting the Dispatch feature could run scripts on a user's PC, and the flaw remains exploitable, they said.

stories.h: OpenAI announces GPT-6 Cyber with claimed critical vulnerability discovery capabilities
stories.s: OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel flaws, created exploits for 948, and found high‑severity bugs in Firefox, while reporting 99.93% scope‑control compliance.

stories.h: Kaspersky reports hacktivists and DDoS‑service sellers forming a joint alliance
